prompts.poses: Four isolated full-body compact chibi watercolor Maddie tabby kitten poses facing left on pure green #00FF00 matching maddie-model-sheet and maddie-idle-sheet with blue collar and yellow star tag: groom (paw lick), stretch (classic cat bow stretch), nap (curled orange cinnamon-roll sleep), cheer (compact happy hop). No ground shadow, no text, no floating icons.

postProcessing.extract: extract-figures.ts connected-component extraction (4 left-facing poses, no flop required)
postProcessing.key: #00FF00 border flood plus enclosed holes (--holes, 18% fuzz, edge despill only)
postProcessing.despill: despill-edge.ts green edge-only despill (band 12 pre-resize and post-resize)
postProcessing.atlas: 4 columns x 1 row alpha-WebP companion atlas (public/assets/characters/maddie/maddie-poses.webp + .json)
postProcessing.review: art/review/e2-maddie-poses-cream.jpg and art/review/e2-maddie-poses-dark.jpg (with base down_idle_01 in slot 0)
